findings.evidence: Dashboard restates filter order, chart types, two-line clamp, and Material/virtualization styling the generated HTML already implements.
findings.fix: Keep only the rules an agent would get wrong: no opt-out on auto-open, turn-identity dedup before token/price sums, family chart does not dedup, inferred family rendering, and execution_certain badge.

findings.evidence: Tool-pattern skill is a procedure plus schema dump; the resolve block is the only decision, and pattern fit is not masterful.
findings.fix: Open with a one-screen decision: installed? then run | classify+dashboard | stop. Move the column glossary behind a read of refined_store.py.

findings.evidence: NEVER list has reasons, but there is no Gotchas section for environment facts that defy the path assumptions.
findings.fix: Add a short Gotchas: capture failure still exits 0; dashboard with no refined.db writes an empty page and still opens the browser; classify prints a Python dict and does not refresh HTML.

findings.evidence: Description has WHAT, WHEN, keywords, and a boundary, but leads with implementation ('Run the local capture-refine-dashboard pipeline') rather than user intent.
findings.fix: Show local usage of Claude Code, opencode, Codex, Cursor, and rtk from session logs as a filterable static HTML dashboard. Use when the user asks about usage metrics, usage dashboard, how they use their AI CLIs, command history across those tools, grep-family invocations grouped by session, or a filterable view of captured shell commands, even without naming the pipeline. Not for exporting or importing data, a hosted dashboard, billing-site spend, cron reports, or explaining a single command.

findings.evidence: SKILL.md is 324 lines and always loads the full refined_commands glossary, dashboard UI, and Codex name list; no optional reference is gated.
findings.fix: Keep resolve, subcommands, After run, and NEVER in SKILL.md. Move the column list and dashboard/Codex detail to references/schema.md and references/dashboard.md, each with a when-to-read line.

findings.evidence: Fragile steps are exact, but the agent is also locked to a column-by-column dashboard description and a hand-written sqlite one-liner the CLI could own.
findings.fix: Default success output to the CLI. Keep the dedup rule as the one exact query; drop the UI inventory the HTML already enforces.

findings.evidence: --help prints only 'usage: ai-kit-usage-metrics.py {capture|refine|dashboard|classify|run}' with no flags, examples, or exit codes; classify prints a Python dict. tests/test_ai_kit_usage_metrics.py smoke-tests run and classify but has no --help assertion.
findings.fix: Make --help list each subcommand, the capture stderr lines, and exit 0/2. Print classify summary as JSON on stdout. Add a test that runs main(['--help']) and main(['nope']).

findings.evidence: 20 queries, 10/10, but negatives are easy off-domain (Grafana, CSV sales, shell startup) rather than near-misses that share usage/dashboard/session keywords.
findings.fix: Replace weak negatives with near-misses: explain rg vs grep, export sessions to a hosted dashboard, cron a spend email, quote one scratch transcript, and chart a sales CSV — keep those — and add 'usage of this repo's API' and 'dashboard mock in Figma'.

findings.evidence: After run says a non-zero exit means show stderr and stop, but cli.py run always returns 0 after capture failures; the only non-zero is unknown subcommand (2). A partial capture still opens the browser.
findings.fix: State that run returns 0 even when stderr has capture[<name>] failed, and that the browser still opens. Treat stderr lines, not the exit code, as the partial-failure signal.
